title: Evaluation of the profinite-point inverse image on a contractible affine
statement: Use the universes of [def-weil-size-convention] and the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $p_X^*=\pi_X^{-1}a^*$ be the geometric inverse image from sheaves on profinite sets defined in [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-point-pullback]. Let $F$ be a sheaf of sets, abelian groups, or commutative rings on profinite sets with finite jointly surjective coverings. Let $U$ be an affine object of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ which is weakly contractible, meaning evaluation at $U$ sends epimorphisms of sheaves of sets to surjections. The quotient space $\pi_0(|U|)$ of connected components is profinite, and there is a canonical identification $(p_X^*F)(U)\cong F(\pi_0(|U|))$, natural in $F$ and in morphisms between such $U$. The identification preserves addition and multiplication when present. The topology on $\pi_0(|U|)$ is the quotient topology: a subset is open if and only if its inverse image in $|U|$ is open.
